subject: The secret workflow 99% of users never discover
preview_text: I tracked how our fastest-healing users actually use the app. Their setup is completely different. Here's the truth...
body_paragraphs: I was looking at the data yesterday, comparing users who heal in 60 days versus those still stuck at 6 months. The difference isn't motivation. It's not even how often they open the app. It's one specific thing they do in the first 5 minutes of setting everything up.

Our top 1%—the people who report feeling 'over it' twice as fast—they don't just journal randomly. They don't use the AI therapist like a 3AM crutch. They build a system. A daily ritual that turns healing from something that happens to them into something they control. They treat their heartbreak like a project with a deadline. And the deadline is their new life.

The secret is in the Custom Coping Strategies feature. But not how you think. Power users don't just pick their breakup type and follow generic advice. They create MULTIPLE strategies. One for mornings when the loneliness hits. One for nights when they're tempted to text. One for when they see their ex in public. They pre-wire their healing for every possible trigger.

Open the app right now. Go to Custom Coping Strategies. Don't just set one. Set three. Name them after your worst moments: 'Monday Morning Dread', 'Friday Night Spiral', 'Social Media Stalker Mode'. Pre-load your own survival instructions. This is how you stop reacting and start directing your own recovery. P.S. The users who do this have a 73% higher no-contact streak. They've essentially hack their own brains to move on.
